Student hospitalized after fight at Rush-Henrietta Senior High School, police say An altercation Thursday morning led to a law enforcement presence at Rush-Henrietta Senior High School, Superintendent Barbara Mullen said in a letter to the community.
Rochester police say a 37-year-old driver crossed into the southbound lane on St. Paul St. and hit a building near Ave C. He was taken to Strong Memorial with life-threatening injuries. Investigation ongoing. March to Abolish Animal Testing ends Saturday with vigil in Wayne County 207-mile March to Abolish Animal Testing ends Saturday at Marshall BioResources, a major U.S. breeder. Activists allege abuse; company cites clean USDA inspections as Congress weighs limits on dog/cat tests.
Rochester police: A dog attacked three people, including a 7-month-old baby, on the west side Saturday night. A bystander stopped it. All were hospitalized with serious injuries; owner not found.
